data.name: True Survival
data.shortDescription: Enhanced survival by removing modern food, drink & meds plus rebalancing hunting, traps & plants.
data.description:
True Survival by OhMyJeeves

Removed Modern Food, Drink & Medicine


  • Medicine
  • Drink Cans
  • Ramen
  • Energy Bars
  • MRE Packs
  • Cereal Boxes
  • Canned Food

Increased Inventory For Meat, Fish & Plant Mixes


  • Fish: Increased to 6 from 3
  • Meat: Increased to 10 from 7
  • Bacon, Steak & Brain Bites: Increased to 5 from 1
  • Health Mix (& +): Increased to 10 from 3
  • Energy Mix (& +): Increased to 10 from 3

Increase Flask Usages


  • Increased Flask Usage: 4 uses instead of 2 to balance removed drinks

Improved Spear For Hunting


  • Thrown Damage: Boosts damage to make it effective for hunting (e.g. one hit kills a deer)
  • Melee Damage: Increases melee damage a small amount to make it a more viable early game weapon

Rebalance Animal Traps & Hutches


  • Fish Traps: Hold 1 fish instead of 5 and slower spawn rate as default is OP
  • Small Rabbit Hutch: Hold 3 rabbits instead of 2 to allow for breeding (10% each sleep)
  • Rabbit Hutch: Increase breed rate to increase viability (50% each sleep)

Rebalance Drops From Animals

  • Squirrels: Drop brain bites to reduce effectiveness of small animal trap and ease of getting meat
  • Raccoons: Drop 1 meat instead of 2 to balance small game hunting
  • Turtles: Drop 2 meat instead of 3 to increase viability of traps / hutches
  • Deer: Drop 2 meat instead of 3 to increase viability of traps / hutches
  • Moose: Drop 4 meat instead of 5 to increase viability of traps / hutches

Rebalance Planters

  • Reduce time for plants to grow from 2 days to 1 day
  • Fix mushrooms so they produce a positive yield on harvest
